decisions.reason: Premium customer support is central to a managed hosting firm’s value proposition and fits the company’s agency-focused, high-service positioning.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm’s hosting and administration capabilities and supports its strategy of reducing customers’ operational work.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively far from the core hosting business and is the most likely candidate to be discontinued so resources can be focused on core platform and support innovation.
Scalable hosting for agencies is highly aligned with the firm’s main customer group and core service offering in a growing market.
